package.description: Your universal AI text processor, powered by local and cloud LLMs. Edit, refactor, and transform text in any application on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

en-US.description: Your universal AI text processor, powered by local and cloud LLMs. Edit, refactor, and transform text in any application on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en-US.longDescription: ProseFlow is a cross-platform desktop application that integrates powerful AI text processing into your daily workflow. With a simple hotkey, you can access a menu of customizable AI actions to proofread, summarize, refactor, or transform text in any application—be it your code editor, browser, or word processor.
en-US.name: ProseFlow

zh-CN.description: 您通用的 AI 文本处理器，由本地和云端大语言模型驱动。可在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上的任何应用程序中编辑、重构和转换文本。
zh-CN.longDescription: ProseFlow 是一款跨平台桌面应用程序，可将强大的 AI 文本处理功能融入您的日常工作中。只需一个简单的快捷键，您就可以访问一系列可自定义的 AI 操作菜单，对任何应用程序中的文本进行校对、摘要、重构或转换，无论是代码编辑器、浏览器还是文字处理软件。
